identity.name: @epdoc/exif
identity.purpose: Read/write EXIF metadata via the exiftool binary with GPS parsing, date resolution, and reverse geocoding

quickStart.pattern: new Reader() → read(paths) → File.resolver for dates → File.applyTags() + write() for updates

exports.name: Reader
exports.description: Factory for bulk EXIF reads in one exiftool invocation; returns File instances
exports.whenToUse: Reading metadata for one or more files efficiently

exports.name: File
exports.description: Wraps a single file's EXIF metadata; provides typed getters, GPS access, and a write queue
exports.whenToUse: Reading or writing tags on a specific file

exports.name: Meta.Resolver
exports.description: Media-agnostic date resolution and write-prepare methods; has fallback chains across EXIF/QuickTime/XMP/IPTC/GPS tags
exports.whenToUse: Getting standardised dates/dimensions/duration/codec regardless of file type

exports.name: Meta.Resolver.buildDateTime
exports.description: Build a DateTime from EXIF date tag values (base + subSec + offset)
exports.whenToUse: Parsing exiftool date tags into a DateTime

exports.name: Meta.Resolver.toExifDateTimeString
exports.description: Format a DateTime as exiftool's 'YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS'
exports.whenToUse: Preparing DateTime values for exiftool write operations

exports.name: Meta.Parse.dateString
exports.description: Parse an exiftool date string into its components (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond, tzOffset)
exports.whenToUse: Reading raw date field values from exiftool output

exports.name: Meta.Parse.duration
exports.description: Normalize an exiftool Duration value to seconds

exports.name: Meta.Parse.json
exports.description: Normalize exiftool -j stdout (object or array) to an array of Metadata objects

exports.name: Gps.parse
exports.description: Convert a DMS or numeric GPS coordinate to decimal degrees

exports.name: Gps.toDms
exports.description: Convert decimal degrees to an exiftool DMS string + hemisphere ref

exports.name: Geo.NominatimApi
exports.description: Client for OpenStreetMap's Nominatim reverse-geocode API; converts GPS coordinates to structured addresses
exports.whenToUse: Looking up human-readable locations from GPS coordinates

exports.name: Geo.buildLocationTags
exports.description: Convert address components into EXIF-compatible location tags at a given granularity
exports.whenToUse: Writing location metadata (country, state, city, sublocation) to EXIF

exports.name: Geo.LocationGranularity
exports.description: Enum controlling how much location detail to write: country | state | city | sublocation | exact

exports.name: dateFromFilename
exports.description: Extract a datetime from a media filename produced by common software (WhatsApp mobile/macOS, Signal, epoch-ms, generic YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS patterns). Returns a wall-clock DateTime; the caller interprets it in a chosen timezone
exports.whenToUse: Deriving a capture/creation date from a filename, e.g. WhatsApp repair fallback or filesystem date strategies

exports.name: Metadata
exports.description: Typed JSON exiftool emits for one file; union of EXIF, IPTC, XMP, video, and document tag families

exports.name: Gps.Location
exports.description: Decimal latitude, longitude, and optional altitude

exports.name: Geo.AddressComponents
exports.description: Structured breakdown of a physical address from reverse geocoding

exports.name: Geo.GeocodeResult
exports.description: Result from a reverse geocode lookup: displayName, lat, lon, and parsed address
